# A hit puff: five pale lumps round a centre and four ochre sparks, origin at the centre (the game scales
# it from small to full and hides it). 0.7 m across at full size. make_env.py.
new
material new Puff --base-color 0.7725 0.8000 0.7216 --no-slot
material new Spark --base-color 0.7451 0.5843 0.3608 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name P0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1500 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.1674 -0.0295 0.0000
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name P1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1500 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 20.0 31.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.0237 -0.1683 0.0400
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name P2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1500 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 40.0 62.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate -0.1528 -0.0745 0.0000
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name P3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1500 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 60.0 93.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate -0.1181 0.1223 0.0400
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name P4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1500 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 80.0 124.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.0798 0.1501 0.0000
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name P5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1500 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 0.0000 0.1300
material assign Puff
add mesh cube --name S0 --size 1 --location 0.2333 0.2333 0.1000
scale 0.0800 0.0800 0.0800
apply --scale
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S1 --size 1 --location -0.2333 0.2333 0.1000
scale 0.0800 0.0800 0.0800
apply --scale
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S2 --size 1 --location -0.2333 -0.2333 0.1000
scale 0.0800 0.0800 0.0800
apply --scale
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S3 --size 1 --location 0.2333 -0.2333 0.1000
scale 0.0800 0.0800 0.0800
apply --scale
material assign Spark
select all
shade flat
export pop.glb
